sources.snippet: Overview CodeLlama-7b-Instruct-hf is an instruction-tuned generative text model with 7 billion parameters, built by meta-llama for general code synthesis, understanding, and instruction following. The model uses an auto-regressive transformer architecture trained between January and July 2023 on the same data as Llama 2 but with different weights emphasizing code. sources.title: CodeLlama-7b-Instruct-hf · Models
sources.snippet: Code Llama Code Llama is a collection of pretrained and fine-tuned generative text models ranging in scale from 7 billion to 34 billion parameters. This is the repository for the 7B instruct-tuned version in the Hugging Face Transformers format. This model is designed for general code synthesis and understanding. Links to other models can be found in the index at the bottom.
